# Opolo

> Opolo helps neurodiverse middle and high school students bridge the gap between their capabilities and getting the work done.

## What Opolo is

Opolo is a homework support tool built specifically for neurodiverse middle and high school students (ages 11 to 16) who experience language processing and executive functioning challenges. The brand exists to reduce student anxiety, surface their capabilities, and prove that progress matters more than perfection.

## Who it is for

Students ages 11 to 16 with executive functioning challenges, ADHD, language processing differences, or similar neurodiverse profiles. Their parents and caregivers are the primary audience for the website.

## Key pages

- Homepage and waitlist: https://www.opololearning.com/
- Our Story: https://www.opololearning.com/our-story
- Research (The Homework Paradox, Parent Survey 2026): https://www.opololearning.com/the-homework-paradox

## Founder

Carol Grant, founder of Opolo. Background in product marketing and go-to-market at Microsoft, Zillow, Syndio, and Storable. Opolo originated from her personal experience navigating the homework support gap for her sons.
